evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 得全阁、海岳开襟
evidence.excerpt_zh: 思永齋西稍南河外為得全閣南為寳雲樓北為逺風樓齋北河池潨滙中有圓式崇基其上樓宇三層為海嶽開襟四旁枋楔各一（長春園册）臣等謹案得全閣額曰天心水面海嶽開襟為下層樓内額其南簷額曰青瑶嶼最上層額曰乗六龍
evidence.summary: South-west of 思永齋: 得全閣 with 寳雲樓 and 逺風樓. North of 思永齋 in the pool: 海嶽開襟, a three-storey building on a round platform, with an arch on each side. The note gives the plaque for each storey.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 得全阁
evidence.summary: Finished 1747 in the south-west: three waterside towers facing east, the main one double-eaved of three bays, plaque 天心水面, with two nine-arch bent wooden bridges; 宝云楼 south and 远风楼 north. Note the same plaque name as the 绮春园 hall QC26.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 宝云楼, 3x1 cells.
